title: The Farmer’s Dog Alternatives: 4 Fresh Food Brands and 2 Treat Boxes
summary: Looking for a Farmer’s Dog alternative? Compare fresh dog food from Ollie, Spot & Tango, Freshpet, and JustFoodForDogs, plus treat boxes to go with it.
body_markdown:
## The alternatives


Closest match


### Ollie vs The Farmer’s Dog


**Best for:** The owner who likes fresh food but wants a lamb recipe or a smaller fresh bill.


[Ollie](https://www.ollie.com/meal-plans/) cooks five fresh recipes (beef, chicken, turkey, pork, and lamb) and ships them frozen in portioned packs. It also sells two baked recipes with the convenience of kibble, and it will mix the two in one plan. The Half Fresh plan covers half your dog’s daily calories, a way to add fresh food to a bowl you already buy.


#### What feels familiar


A short quiz about your dog, frozen packs portioned to match, and recipes made to AAFCO standards for every life stage.


#### What changes


Lamb joins the menu, and so do half and mixed plans. Ollie puts its average at $8 a day, so get a quote for your own dog before you switch. Packs need a full day to thaw in the fridge, and you cancel by phone or on the website, not in the app.


No freezer space


### Spot & Tango UnKibble vs The Farmer’s Dog


**Best for:** A small freezer, or a dog who does better on fish.


[Spot & Tango](https://www.spotandtango.com/unkibble) makes UnKibble by gently cooking and freeze-drying fresh ingredients, so the food keeps in a cool, dry pantry. The three recipes are beef and barley, turkey and sweet potato, and cod and salmon, which the brand labels grain-free. Spot & Tango also sells a frozen fresh line if you want both.


#### What feels familiar


Ingredients from human-food suppliers, a plan priced to your dog’s calorie needs, and deliveries you can pause or cancel from your account.


#### What changes


It starts at about $1 a day, half The Farmer’s Dog’s starting price. You scoop it straight from the bag, a drier bite than a thawed fresh pack. Mixing UnKibble and frozen meals on one plan takes a call to the company.


No subscription


### Freshpet vs The Farmer’s Dog


**Best for:** Buying fresh dog food with the weekly groceries.


[Freshpet](https://www.freshpet.com/) sells refrigerated rolls and bags from its own fridges in grocery, pet, and big-box stores. Its latest quarterly filing counts about 30,700 stores with a Freshpet fridge. There’s nothing to schedule and nothing to cancel.


#### What feels familiar


Steam-cooked food with no preservatives, kept cold from kitchen to fridge and made to AAFCO standards, plus a delivery plan if you want one. Freshpet Delivery starts at $2 a day for a full plan or $1 for a half plan.


#### What changes


Store rolls and bags aren’t portioned for your dog, so you work out how much to feed, and an opened roll lasts 7 days in the fridge. Some delivery recipes are for adult dogs only, and delivery doesn’t reach every ZIP code yet.


Vet diets and more proteins


### JustFoodForDogs vs The Farmer’s Dog


**Best for:** A dog with a health condition your vet is managing, or one who can’t eat the usual proteins.


[JustFoodForDogs](https://justfoodfordogs.com/) cooks fresh frozen recipes in fish, lamb, venison, beef, chicken, turkey, and tofu, plus a prescription line for conditions such as kidney, liver, and digestive care. You can order once without subscribing, buy at its own kitchens, or pick it up at Petco and Pet Food Express.


#### What feels familiar


Gently cooked food frozen in portioned packs, formulated by veterinary nutritionists.


#### What changes


Pricing goes by the box: $154 for 14 packs of Chicken & Rice ordered once, and the site helps you pick a box size that fits your freezer. Orders under $49 pay $19.99 shipping. It doesn’t ship to Alaska or Hawaii.


Alongside any fresh plan


### PAWsitively Organic Dog Bakery vs The Farmer’s Dog


[Organic Dog Treat Subscription Box | Handmade Bakery Treats for Dogs](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/choose-your-subscription-plan-pawsitivelyorganicdogbakery) by PAWsitively-Organic-Dog-Bakery


From $33.00 / box


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/choose-your-subscription-plan-pawsitivelyorganicdogbakery)


**Best for:** Treats held to the same ingredient standard as your dog’s dinner.


PAWsitively Organic Dog Bakery bakes three or four kinds of treats in small batches in New Jersey each month, with organic, human-grade ingredients and no corn, soy, or artificial preservatives. Think pumpkin muffins, peanut butter donuts, and decorated cookies.


#### What feels familiar


Human-grade ingredients, food made fresh for each order, and a monthly delivery you don’t have to remember.


#### What changes


These are treats. The Farmer’s Dog portions each pack to your dog’s daily calories, so anything from this box comes on top of that count. Boxes are baked after billing and ship around the 15th.


Something to chew


### PupJoy Power Chewers Box vs The Farmer’s Dog


[Monthly PupJoy Power Chewers Box, Treats & Toys, All Natural](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/pupjoy) by PupJoy


From $37.00 / box


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/pupjoy)


**Best for:** A dog who finishes a soft fresh meal in seconds and still wants something to work on.


PupJoy sends a monthly mix of treats and sturdier toys, sized from Tea Cup to Huuuge. The seller calls the treats all natural and lets you change what comes in the box.


#### What feels familiar


A monthly delivery set to your dog’s size, and no contract to sign.


#### What changes


No food at all. This box covers chewing and play, the part of the day a bowl of fresh food finishes quickly. It ships within a business day of your order.
